plain.source:
using System.Data.SqlClient;
class P { void M() { var c = new SqlConnection(s); } }

other-package.source:
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
class P { void M() { var c = new SqlCommand(s); } }

implicit-new.source:
using System.Data.SqlClient;
class P { void M() { SqlConnection c = new(s); } }

nullable-implicit-new.source:
using System.Data.SqlClient;
class P { SqlConnection? c = new(); }

using-static.source:
using static System.Data.SqlClient.SqlConnection;
class P { void M() { ClearAllPools(); } }

using-alias.source:
using Sql = System.Data.SqlClient;
class P { void M() { var c = new Sql.SqlConnection(s); } }

interpolation.source:
using System.Data.SqlClient;
class P { void M() { var s = $"{new SqlConnection(x)}"; } }

arrow-lambda.source:
using System.Data.SqlClient;
class P { System.Func<SqlConnection> f = () => new SqlConnection(); }

shadowed-by-local.source:
using System.Data.SqlClient;
class P { void M(Foo SqlConnection) { SqlConnection.Open(); } }
